brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-023 in preference to accepting exposure for this ageing unit, as the supplied documents do not cover addressing the specific oil issue noted in the asset facts. Record any de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, rather than when the event ends, as instructed in MG-021.
